source: Selected low-detail pixel blacksmith spirit with a single hammer
motion: Continuous independent head, eyes, shoulder/hammer and free-arm transforms; asymmetric blink timing; continuous pre-impact arm and body compression; fine-grid flame silhouette with a steadier face and rising inner-color flow; irregular contour-shed embers with three silhouettes, varied scale, curl and cooling; distance-spaced drag embers; strike-synchronized sparks; smooth forge recovery. Native 60Hz renderer. macOS Reduce Motion disables motion and particles.
review: Menu > 기본 동작 확인; preview uses a separate scene and never modifies real Codex session state.

interaction.technicalDebt: Rig-sized rectangular input target covers body, head, flame and hammer with a small margin. Transparent gaps inside the target also receive clicks; outer window corners remain click-through. Not per-pixel silhouette routing.

limitations: The flame is procedurally rendered on an approximately 1pt grid in the 64pt rig, using the original atlas contour. It is not an authored sprite-sheet animation. No anvil or impact sound.
